# Spray Foam Insurance Agency

> Spray Foam Insurance Agency (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for spray foam insulation contractors in all 50 states. Coverage lines: general liability with spray foam endorsements, off-ratio coverage for A:B component mix errors, contractor pollution liability (CPL) for VOC and isocyanate exposure, workers' compensation for spray foam crews, commercial auto for spray rigs and proportioner trucks, tools and equipment coverage for proportioners and spray guns, commercial umbrella, and contractor license and surety bonds. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
